paragraphs.text: Door repairs often begin with the everyday symptom: a door that catches, does not sit comfortably in the frame, needs extra force to close, or leaves a visible gap at the latch side. A good enquiry describes what happens during normal use and includes clear images of the door edge, hinges, handle and strike where safe to photograph.

This record concerns latch and closing alignment. Report whether your door rubs, fails to latch or has loose hardware; those symptoms do not necessarily need the same adjustment. Compare the repair scope: Door Repairs.

本记录涉及门闩和关闭对齐。请说明您家门是否擦碰、无法锁合或五金松动；这些症状不一定需要相同调整。比较维修范围： 门维修。
